## ⚠️ 首先：**本卡正文里的三个数字已经被更正过了，而更正没有回到本卡**

本卡写「about **52** members」「reads exactly **seven** members」「~**45**」。这三个数在 **#7928** 的更正说明（2026-09-06T04:0xZ）与 **#7947** 里已被改成：

| 本卡写 | 现行 |
|---|---|
| about 52 members | **47** 个已声明顶层成员 |
| reads exactly seven | **六个已声明的**读成员（第七个 `data` **根本没声明**，经 `as any` 进入） |
| ~45 unread | **41** 未读（47 − 6） |

**本席独立复现了「52 从哪来」**：对 `NamedListView` 跑一个**不排除嵌套对象字面量行**的朴素正则得 **59** ⇒ 正是 #7928 指认的那个「更宽的仪器」。⇒ 52 介于 47 与 59 之间，**两个都不是**。

⇒ ⚠️ **本卡是那三个错误数字仍未更正的第五个站点**（#7947 列了四个：changeset、`objectql.zod.ts` docblock、`zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` 的 note、`object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.test.ts` 的头部）。⛔ **本席不改卡片正文**（那是填卡席的），但**任何引用本卡的人请引用 47 / 41 / 六**。⚠️ **PR #7969 正在修那四个站点——建议它顺手也更正本卡的正文，或在本卡留一条更正说明。**

## 落点核实（`origin/main`）——机制成立

`packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` 对 `currentNamedViewConfig` 的读取点，本席取到的与卡片一致：
```
:712   const currentNamedViewConfig: NamedListView | null = useMemo(() => {
:767   if (currentNamedViewConfig?.type) return currentNamedViewConfig.type;
:839   currentNamedViewConfig?.filter || activeViewQueryInputs?.filter
:874   const sort = currentNamedViewConfig?.sort || activeViewQueryInputs?.sort
:1189  fields: currentNamedViewConfig?.columns || activeView?.columns
:1200  const viewOptions = currentNamedViewConfig?.options || activeView || {};
:1518  const viewFilter = currentNamedViewConfig?.filter || activeView?.filter;
:1519  const viewSort = currentNamedViewConfig?.sort || activeView?.sort;
```
⇒ `type` / `filter` / `sort` / `columns` / `options`（+ `label`，+ 经 `as any` 的 `data`）——**与「六个已声明 + 一个未声明」相符。**

⭐ **而卡片对「其余的键从哪来」的论证是本卡最有价值的部分**，本席背书：
> Every other key the `renderListView` delegation forwards comes from **`activeView`** — the host's `views` prop — **never from the named view**: `rowHeight: activeView?.rowHeight`, `navigation: activeView?.navigation ?? (schema as any).navigation`, `searchableFields: activeView?.searchableFields ?? …` (`ObjectView.tsx:1745`–`:1822`).

⇒ **所以一个用 `rowHeight` / `navigation` / `selection` / `pagination` / `searchableFields` / `showSearch` 等编排的命名视图，会 passthrough 校验通过并且什么都不改变——而已发布的类型正在邀请作者去写它们。**

## 定级理由

- **`domain:spec`**：落点 `packages/types/src/objectql.ts` 的 `NamedListView` 声明 ⇒ objectui 的 `domain:spec`。
- **`enhancement` + `finding`**：main 上没有东西是**假的**（passthrough 是刻意的、被记录的）；交付物是一次**逐成员活性普查**，之后要么走 #7129 的 `?: never` 墓碑路线、要么开一张实现卡让委托真的从命名视图读那些键。两条都改变已发布面 ⇒ Feature 侧。
- **p3**：⛔ 无运行期故障、无数据风险；损害是**已发布类型邀请作者写下 41 个无效成员**。⛔ 不降更低：**它挡着 #7928 的裁决**（`listViews` 镜像的值类型），而那张卡自陈「D 是零成本的现状，可以一直挂着」⇒ 本卡是解锁它的那一步，但不紧急。

## 承接指引

**交付物 = 逐成员活性普查**（本卡自陈：*"A per-member liveness census on `NamedListView` itself"*）。⇒ **这一步是可排期的，⛔ 不需要裁决。**

⚠️ **普查必须一并回答 `data`**：#7928 明写 *"the seventh read key, `data`, has to be **declared or its cast removed** as part of it"*，且指明 `data` 的归属地就是本卡。⇒ ⛔ **一次不回答 `data` 的普查是不完整的。**

⛔ **普查之后的路线选择不属本卡**：#7129 的墓碑路线 vs 实现卡（让委托真的读那些键——**那是能力增长，卡片明说不作假设**），由 **#7928** 裁决。⇒ **本卡交普查，#7928 决方向。**

⚠️ **排期依赖**：本轮同批路由的 **#7947** 正在把守护这条决定的 pin 从 `toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(40)` 收成精确的 `toBe(47)`。⇒ **#7947 先落**，否则普查期间若声明收缩，今天的下限不会报警——而那恰恰是会重开 #7928 的条件。

**Refs**：objectui#7779 · PR #7922 · **#7928**（值类型裁决，含更正后的数字）· **#7947**（四个站点的数字更正与 pin 收紧）· objectui#2890（ObjectView / DetailView 审计）· objectui#6152（镜像对 worklist —— ⭐ 卡片正确指出这是**另一件仪器**：这个声明没有 zod 孪生可入账）。

objectui#7779 is stuck on it: `ViewSchema.listViews`'s mirror cannot be settled while ~45 of `NamedListView`'s ~52 declared members have unknown liveness, and `listViews` stays in the parity ledger until it is. The census is the input that decision needs.

## ⛔ Re-derive every figure — the card body's numbers are a year-old reading

The body says "about 52 members" and "exactly seven read" and pins the seven against `packages/types/src/__tests__/object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.test.ts`. Those were measured on `6a9ee323`. **`main` has moved many times a day since.** Re-derive both halves on your own head:

- the declared member set of `NamedListView` (`packages/types/src/objectql.ts`, around `:1957`–`:2134` on the old head — ⛔ re-locate it, do not trust the line numbers) with a **TypeScript AST walk** (`ts.createSourceFile`, visiting the interface's `PropertySignature` members), ⛔ **not** brace-depth counting and ⛔ not a regex — my own brace parser failed to terminate at an object's close on objectui#8071 (`5602705803`), and the existing pin file's regex derivation is exactly the instrument you are supposed to improve on;

The card records those as two different sources at `:1745`–`:1822` and that distinction is the whole point — a member "read" via `activeView?.rowHeight` is **not** read off the named view.

**Every count needs a firing control on the same instrument.** A member you claim is unread must be measured by a probe that finds a member you know IS read (`label`, `type`, `columns`, `filter`, `sort`, `options`, `data` per the old reading) — otherwise "0 reads" is a parser that found nothing. And ⚠️ the old reading notes `data` is reached **through an `as any` cast and is not even declared**; a probe keyed on declared members will miss it. Report that class if it still holds.

⛔ **Capture every exit code into a file BEFORE any pipe** (`cmd > out 2>&1; RC=$?`), never off the end of `cmd | tail`.

1. **The census, pinned as a test.** Prefer extending the existing pin (`packages/types/src/__tests__/object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.test.ts`) over a new file if it is the same instrument — read it end to end first and say which you chose and why. The pin must fail if a member moves between the read and unread sets in either direction; prove that with an **ablation** (mutate `ObjectView.tsx` to read one currently-unread member, prove the mutation on disk by blob hash before reading any result, watch exactly the expected row go red, restore from a `trap … EXIT INT TERM` and prove restoration by blob hash — ⛔ never by an exit code).
2. **A changeset** (`.changeset/*.md`). ⛔ Never touch `content/docs/releases/`.
3. **The card update** — post the full per-member table as an `os-dev-report` comment on this card; the PM turns it into the ruling request. ⛔ Do not file the ruling card yourself and ⛔ do not close this card.

## What is now settled, and what is not

**Settled — the measurement.** 47 declared members (a plain interface: no heritage clause, no index signature, no computed member, so its property signatures *are* the population; exactly one required member, `label`). Seven names read off a named view, six of them declared. The partition **6 + 41 = 47**, disjoint and exhaustive, each member pinned **by name** so a move fails in **either** direction.

⛔ **Not settled — the disposition, for any of the 41.** Both routes are maintainer rulings: `?: never` tombstones **narrow a published accept set**; making the delegation read the members is **capability growth**.
